options.content: **Claude Code 2.1 — same harness, different upstream.** Real Anthropic Claude (via DIAL) vs OSS models routed through the same DIAL gateway. Filter with `$client` (wrapper) and `$family` (upstream provider). Read: table → trends → wire-health → productivity.

panels.title: Models in play — by (wrapper, model) in window
panels.description: One row per (client.name, model) combination with traffic in the selected window. Columns from Claude Code's OTel SDK. 'Turns / session' is mean count of token-usage emit events per session.id (higher = more conversation turns for the same task — Gemini council called this the actual viability signal). 'Cost USD' is claude_code.cost.usage which IS populated for OSS upstreams via DIAL response usage echo.

targets.query:

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus")

panels.title: Latency p50 (ms) — by family
panels.description: End-to-end wall-clock from /v1/messages POST to upstream stream completion, by upstream family. Source: adapter_metrics — bridge wire-level. Lower is better. Legend shows last / mean / max so you can eyeball stability vs absolute number.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "dial-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "adapter_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "end_to_end_p50_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target_model_family != "none" and r.target_model_family != "unknown")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["client.name"], set: ${client:json}))

panels.title: Cost USD per minute — SDK self-reported (OSS over-charged)
panels.description: **Source:** Claude Code SDK's `claude_code.cost.usage`. Charges Anthropic models correctly against an internal price table, but **falls back to Opus rates ($5/$25 per 1M) for any unrecognised upstream**, so OSS models (Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, DeepSeek) appear ~10× more expensive here than they actually are. Use **'Estimated cost per family'** below for Bedrock-verified pricing computed by the DIAL adapter.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "dial-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "claude_code.cost.usage" and r._value > 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["client.name"], set: ${client:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.model =~ /^(${family:regex})\.|^global\.(${family:regex})\.|^(us|eu|apac|ap|sa|ca)\.(${family:regex})\./ or (r.model =~ /^claude-/ and contains(value: "anthropic", set: ${family:json})))
  |> group(columns: ["model","session.id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> difference(nonNegative: true, columns: ["_value"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value)
  |> group(columns: ["model"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Cache-control behaviour by upstream family
panels.description: How the bridge handles cache_control markers per family. translated_dial_breakpoint = sent on to DIAL as a cache marker (Anthropic only). dropped_non_anthropic_upstream = stripped because DIAL Qwen/Gemma/DeepSeek routes reject cache markers (would otherwise return 502 No route).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "dial-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "adapter_metrics" and (
        r._field == "cache_control_strat_translated_dial_breakpoint" or
        r._field == "cache_control_strat_dropped_non_anthropic_upstream"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target_model_family != "none" and r.target_model_family != "unknown")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["client.name"], set: ${client:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["target_model_family"], set: ${family:json}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with strategy:
        if r._field == "cache_control_strat_translated_dial_breakpoint" then "translated"
        else "dropped" }))
  |> group(columns: ["target_model_family","strategy"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Tool success rate — by client + tool
panels.description: Per-(client, tool) success ratio from claude_code_events tool_result. Computed as success_count / (success + failure). Green ≥ 95%, yellow 80–95%, red < 80%.

targets.query:
succ = from(bucket: "dial-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "claude_code_events" and r._field == "count" and r.event_name == "tool_result")
  |> group(columns: ["client_name","tool_name","success"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["client_name","tool_name"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["client_name","tool_name"], columnKey: ["success"], valueColumn: "_value")
ratio = succ
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        client_name: r.client_name,
        tool_name: r.tool_name,
        _value: float(v: if exists r["true"] then r["true"] else 0) /
                float(v: (if exists r["true"] then r["true"] else 0) + (if exists r["false"] then r["false"] else 0)),
        _field: "success_rate"
     }))
ratio
  |> group(columns: ["client_name","tool_name"])

  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["client.name","type","_value"])

options.content: **Hooks, permission escalations, compaction, and TTFT — OSS harness friction beyond raw latency.**  Surfaces hook failures, deliberate bypassPermissions transitions, compaction pressure, and beta-trace time-to-first-token by upstream model family.

panels.title: Hook execution health — blocking + non-blocking errors
panels.description: Per-minute sum of num_blocking + num_non_blocking_error from claude_code.hook_execution_complete, grouped by client and hook_event. 0 = green, ≥1 yellow, ≥5 red.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "dial-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "claude_code_events" and r._field == "hook_errors" and r.event_name == "hook_execution_complete")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.client_name, set: ${client:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["client_name","hook_event"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Compaction events — count + avg token delta
panels.description: claude_code.compaction: per-minute event count (A) and mean pre→post token delta (B). Rising compaction frequency flags OSS context pressure.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "dial-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "claude_code_events" and r.event_name == "compaction" and r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.client_name, set: ${client:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["client_name","trigger","success"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "dial-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "claude_code_events" and r.event_name == "compaction" and r._field == "token_delta")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.client_name, set: ${client:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["client_name","trigger","success"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Permission mode escalations (to bypassPermissions)
panels.description: Count of claude_code.permission_mode_changed transitions into bypassPermissions (audit signal). 0 = green, any = yellow.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "dial-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "claude_code_events" and r._field == "count" and r.event_name == "permission_mode_changed" and r.to_mode == "bypassPermissions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.client_name, set: ${client:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["client_name"])
  |> sum()

panels.title: TTFT p50 / p95 (ms) — by model family (beta traces)
panels.description: From measurement claude_code_traces (sidecar projects claude_code.llm_request spans with ttft_ms). Requires OTLP traces enabled on the collector + claude-code-traces-exporter. p50 (A) and p95 (B) per target_model_family per minute.

targets.query:
import "experimental"
from(bucket: "dial-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "claude_code_traces" and r._field == "ttft_ms" and r.span_name == "llm_request")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.client_name, set: ${client:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["target_model_family"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.50, column: column), createEmpty: false)

import "experimental"
from(bucket: "dial-metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "claude_code_traces" and r._field == "ttft_ms" and r.span_name == "llm_request")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.client_name, set: ${client:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["target_model_family"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column), createEmpty: false)
